In its searches, despite the ambiguity and multiple works sharing the same title, WebSurfer did not attempt to refine its search terms or use additional context (such as "film-to-stage adaptation") to clarify results. Consequently, the results remained noisy and inconclusive throughout the conversation, filled with unrelated references. This omission caused redundant iterations and a lack of progress in resolving the user’s query accurately.
